import numpy as np

# Load both runs
data_normal = np.load('/work/fwd/r2/run.npz')
data_ablated = np.load('/work/fwd/r4/run.npz')

# Compare L0_MLP write with and without L0H0 ablated
# For input 2 (ascending 1-9) in r2 (index 2) vs r4 (index 1)
mlp_normal = data_normal['L0_MLP'][2]  # ascending in r2
mlp_ablated = data_ablated['L0_MLP'][1]  # ascending in r4

print("L0_MLP write - normal vs ablated L0H0:")
print("Normal norms:", np.round(np.linalg.norm(mlp_normal, axis=-1), 3))
print("Ablated norms:", np.round(np.linalg.norm(mlp_ablated, axis=-1), 3))

# Compute difference
diff = mlp_normal - mlp_ablated
print("\nDiff norms:", np.round(np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=-1), 3))

# Check if L0H0 is a significant fraction of the MLP input
print("\nRelative change:", np.round(np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=-1) / np.linalg.norm(mlp_normal, axis=-1), 3))

import numpy as np

data = np.load('/work/fwd/r6/run.npz')
mlp = data['L0_MLP']

print("L0_MLP norms with L0H0 ablated:")
print("Input 0 (all 1s):", np.round(np.linalg.norm(mlp[0], axis=-1), 2))
print("Input 1 (all 5s):", np.round(np.linalg.norm(mlp[1], axis=-1), 2))
print("Input 2 (all 9s):", np.round(np.linalg.norm(mlp[2], axis=-1), 2))
print("Input 3 (mixed):", np.round(np.linalg.norm(mlp[3], axis=-1), 2))

# Check cosine similarity between all-1s and all-9s
for pos in [1, 5, 9]:
    v1 = mlp[0, pos]
    v9 = mlp[2, pos]
    cos = np.dot(v1, v9) / (np.linalg.norm(v1) * np.linalg.norm(v9))
    diff = np.linalg.norm(v1 - v9)
    print(f"\nPos {pos}: all-1s vs all-9s: cosine={cos:.4f}, diff_norm={diff:.2f}")

# Also compare same-position same-token vs different-token 
print("\n--- Pos 1 (token 1 vs 5 vs 9) ---")
for i, tok in [(0, 1), (1, 5), (2, 9)]:
    print(f"Token {tok} at pos 1: {np.round(mlp[i, 1][:6], 2)}")
